subject: TrustBridge audit intake pipeline & integration play
messages:
From: Devon Lee <devon@trustbridge.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: TrustBridge integration - audit intake pipeline question

Hi Kimberly / Marcus,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. We at TrustBridge are ready to start the evidence ingestion pilot for our shared customers. Before we schedule engineering time, a couple of practical questions so we scope the pilot correctly: 

- Desired delivery format: you mentioned both S3 pull and HTTPS post — which is preferred for SOC2 artifacts?
- Do you support per-account redaction rules (PII masks) or do we need to pre-redact before sending?
- Expected retention window for artifacts once ingested into Redwood's platform (30/90/365 days)?

I've attached a draft SOW and a small sample_log_manifest.csv showing typical artifact names and sizes.

Attaching: trustbridge_sow_v1.docx, sample_log_manifest.csv

Happy to jump on a 30m sync if that helps.

Best,
Devon
Devon Lee
Head of Integrations, TrustBridge
devon@trustbridge.io
+1 (415) 555-0183
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Devon Lee <devon@trustbridge.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TrustBridge integration - audit intake pipeline question

Devon — thanks for the materials, this is a good starting point. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Preferred transport: S3 pull (signed least-privileged role) for bulk artifact delivery; HTTPS POST is acceptable for small, frequent uploads (webhook). We'll outline both in the MAP.
- Redaction: Redwood can apply per-account redaction on ingest (we rely on a redaction profile + regex rules). However, for legal/regulatory artifacts customers often prefer that partners pre-redact PII. Let's make pre-redaction optional but supported — include redaction_guidelines.pdf for your reviewers.
- Retention: default retention for partner-ingested artifacts is 90 days, with options to extend to 365 for enterprise contracts.

Next steps I propose:
1) Mutual action plan (MAP) draft for logistics and Milestones (we'll add timelines for S3 role provisioning, test ingestion, and verification).
2) Security questionnaire: please share your pen-test SOC2 attestations and any relevant artifact access controls.
3) Tech sync: 45 minutes with our infra eng and partner integrations team.

I'm attaching our redaction_guidelines.pdf and a quick MAP skeleton (mutual_action_plan.md). Marcus / Neha — can you confirm bandwidth for next week?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Partner Security & Integrations
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
From: Devon Lee <devon@trustbridge.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Claire Dawson <claire@northpointsec.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TrustBridge integration - audit intake pipeline question

Thanks, Kimberly — this is helpful. Quick answers inline: 

- We can provision an S3 bucket with a short-lived role. S3 pull works for bulk.
- We'll pre-redact anything that could be considered PII by default; good to have your patterns to verify.
- 90 days retention is fine for the pilot.

Claire from Northpoint (our security partner / external pen-test coordinator) is looped in — they own our SOC2 artifacts and will share the latest attestations and a small sample evidence package so you can validate ingest. 

I've uploaded the SOW and manifest to our workspace; attaching again for convenience.

Attaching: trustbridge_sow_v1.docx, sample_log_manifest.csv

Would propose the tech sync Tuesday 2027-04-27 at 10:00 PT — does that work for your team?

—Devon
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Devon Lee <devon@trustbridge.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 11:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TrustBridge integration - audit intake pipeline question

Devon / Kimberly — Tuesday works on our side. A couple quick operational notes so the sync is productive: 

- Please share a short (1-page) list of artifact types with example filepaths you expect to send—this helps our parsing rules map quickly.
- We'll provision a dedicated S3 role scoped to the pilot account (no cross-account wildcard access).
- For the pilot we usually run an ingest validation run (publish to a staging bucket) and then a verification checklist step with Northpoint or your pen-test partner.

Linking a MAP draft for the call: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QxT-TrustBridge-Onboarding-Plan
I've created JIRA:TICKET-3921 to track the S3 role and staging run.

Neha — can you bring the ingest validation checklist and a short note on redaction/retention defaults?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Partner Integrations PM
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: TrustBridge integration - audit intake pipeline question

All — adding the checklist below and confirming attachments we'll need from TrustBridge before the sync:

Required pre-call artifacts:
- Sample evidence bundle (subset) in staging format (filename prefix sample_)*
- List of artifact types + expected frequency and average size
- Contact for S3 role provisioning and an IAM principal to map
- Copy of most recent SOC2 report or attestation (Claire will assist if needed)

We'll validate ingest using the following steps during the pilot:
1) Staging ingest to our validation bucket
2) Automated schema & hash checks against sample manifest
3) Redaction verification (automated regex + manual spot-check)
4) Retention policy enforcement test (90d TTL)
5) Evidence accessibility & audit logging check (ensure access events are recorded to our audit trail)

Attaching internal redaction guidance & MAP skeleton: redaction_guidelines.pdf, mutual_action_plan.md

See you on Tue 2027-04-27 10:00 PT.
